homepage_review.suggested_excerpt: I created civica.uk to make everyday Home Assistant controls clearer for the whole household, including older relatives, neurodivergent people and guests. This independent project adapts GOV.UK design principles and reusable patterns into predictable layouts, readable text and clear actions. It uses its own identity and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the UK government.
